objective: Make the Early Access hero map read as a real reference map (province borders, cursor magnifier, per-city landmark art) and expand the interactive product demo plan with the field-level detail needed to build and accept the next demo slices.
architectureContracts: lib/map-geometry.ts is generated only by scripts/build-map.mjs from Natural Earth 1:50m admin-0 and admin-1 GeoJSON; never hand-edit it.
MAP_VIEWBOX.bounds is derived from the admin-0 selection alone so MAP_CITIES projection stays stable when province geometry is regenerated.
LANDMARK_ART keys must stay 1:1 with MAP_CITIES ids; a missing key renders an empty symbol.
Landmark glyphs are authored on a 32x32 grid, stroke-only, coloured through currentColor; stroke width is set per usage, not in the symbol.
The hero map plate never pans, rolls or zooms on its own; only the pointer-driven lens transforms, and only for fine pointers.
Product Demo copy stays centralized and bilingual in lib/copy.ts.
The frozen waitlist API, validation, rate limit and the direct JotForm CTA were not touched.
assumptions: Operator approved hand-drawn SVG landmark line art over sourced photography, so no third-party image licence is involved.
Operator approved direct implementation of the map slice by Claude rather than dispatching it to Codex.
Operator approved pushing this slice straight to main, which triggers a Vercel production deploy.

verification.summary: Rendered every glyph at 96px against the city and place names; Hohhot, Shanghai, Hangzhou, Zhengzhou and Shenzhen were redrawn after the first pass and re-reviewed.
Coarse pointer disabled the lens and the cursor hint; the static plate, province borders, rotating highlight and the landmark callout all rendered without horizontal overflow.
No console errors on a fresh load or after lens interaction. One dependency-array warning appeared only across a Fast Refresh boundary and did not reproduce after a full reload.
earlyaccess.go2china.space returned 200 with 31 province paths and the lm-* landmark symbols in the HTML, and the deployed stylesheet contains the new province, lens and callout rules.

verification.command: prefers-reduced-motion regression on the rewritten map
verification.summary: The reduced-motion guard was rewritten (autoplay suppressed, marker pulse and callout transition disabled) but not executed under an emulated reduced-motion setting; the browser pane offers no such emulation here.
Not rerun; this slice did not touch the API, validation, rate limit or provider path.
Not submitted; public CTAs continue to link directly to the operator-provided JotForm URL.
Only 375x812 was checked this round; the expanded plan lists 430x932 as a standing requirement.

risks: lib/map-geometry.ts grew from about 13 KB to about 43 KB gzipped because it now carries 31 simplified province outlines. Raise EPSILON in scripts/build-map.mjs if the hero payload becomes a problem.
Province borders come from Natural Earth 1:50m admin-1 and are drawn per province, so shared borders are stroked twice; this is only visible as a slightly denser dashed line.
The landmark glyphs are stylised interpretations, not surveyed drawings; they must never be presented as photographs of the real places.
operatorActions: Confirm the public JotForm URL remains current.
Decide whether the expanded demo plan (docs/interactive-product-demo-plan.md sections 10 to 17) should be split into GitHub issues for Codex, and in which order.
Replace the CSS POI and dish image placeholders inside the Product Demo with approved project-local assets in a later image pass; the hero map no longer needs an image pass.
